Callout.Name: Rough Sleeper Concern
Callout.Message: Person sleeping in a shop doorway in freezing weather.
Callout.Advisory: Male, no visible injuries, business complaining.

Script.Line: I am in a doorway because it is minus four outside.
I have not been asked to move by anybody except you.
There is a shelter on the other road. It is full. I checked.

Lines.Approach: He is in the doorway and it is below freezing. Whatever the business wants, check on him first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
